Name: Old Mariner To Mermaid
Author: peaachdew
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][b]disclaimer:[/b][/color] this mod is a 1.5 update & fix for the original mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43320952][color=#fce5cd]campanulamis[/color][/url][b] [/b](mioudew) which can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2604?tab=description][color=#fce5cd]here[/color][/url]. the original mod has several issues (overwriting newer game content, overriding language selection, some minor grammatical problems), so i remade a content patcher mod for it. there is already a working content patcher version which can be found [url=https://github.com/dragonmaus/mermaids-replace-old-mariner][color=#fce5cd]here[/color][/url], however mine is different because the mermaids do not change with the seasons, instead they are configurable.

**i have never modded stardew valley before this, so if there are any bugs/errors/suggestions you have please let me know.**

[color=#f4cccc][b]description:
[/b][/color]this is a configurable stardew valley mod that replaces the old mariner with a mermaid. you can choose which mermaid to replace him with in the configs.

[color=#f4cccc][b]known issues﻿:[/b][/color]
❀ the mermaid dialogue will only activate if you have your language set to english. however, the mermaid sprite will still activate regardless of the language.
❀ all three mermaids have essentially the same dialogue.

[color=#f4cccc][b]installation:
[/b][/color]1. requires the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#fce5cd]content patcher[/color][/url] & [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#fce5cd]smapi[/color][color=#ffffff].[/color]
[/url]2. download this mod.
3. extract the mod folder into your sttardew valley\mods directory.
4. run the game using smapi.

[color=#f4cccc][b]configs:
[/b][/color]the type of mermaid in your game:
﻿﻿"Mermaid": "Delphine/Sabrina/Pearl"

[color=#f4cccc][b]credit:
[/b][/color]all credit goes to mioudew for the sprites & to dragonmaus for the dialogue.
i have permission from mioudew to use these assets & upload this mod fix.[/font]
